noise_temporal_policy: one fixed RGB spatial noise field per episode, shared across all frames and chunks
parameter_identity: environment plus episode_index; independent of method, chunk, and access order
augmentation_stage: loaded resized RGB video, before VAE encoding and first-frame extraction
formula: clip(((x ** gamma - 0.5) * contrast + 0.5) * gain * tint * (1 + gx * xx + gy * yy) + offset + noise, 0, 1)
quantization: round to uint8, then restore the loader's [-1,1] float tensor convention
query_and_support_selection: unchanged from the original 40-query / 16-support Stick reference
query_GT_usage: comparison only; never used for adaptation or future conditioning
